title: L2MAC: Large Language Model Automatic Computer

defines.name: L2MAC
defines.definition: An LLM-based multi-agent stored-program automatic computer framework for generating long and coherent outputs under a fixed context window.

defines.name: Code-L2MAC
defines.definition: A practical instantiation of L2MAC for generating large, internally consistent codebases from detailed user-specified tasks.

problem: Fixed context windows and simplistic memory management prevent LLMs from producing long, coherent, and internally consistent outputs such as large codebases.
